_comment: Manually curated, not exported by the Python engine. Keys are exact-match names, namespaced by hierarchy to avoid cross-city collisions ('City', 'City::Corridor', 'City::Corridor::Society'). No entry for a name = PlaceholderTile fallback, which is the honest default, not an error state. Add an image: drop the file in web/public/assets/images/ and add its path here. See DECISIONS.md for why there is no live scraping/hotlinking of real-estate photos. Any entry marked illustrative in _meta is generic stock, not a real photo of that specific place - see that entry's note before treating it as depicting the real city/corridor/society. See PROGRESS.md's image slot table for what's still wanted before showtime. The hero landing image is NOT in this manifest - it's a single fixed asset (web/public/assets/images/hero-towers-dusk.jpg), not an entity lookup, so it's referenced directly in Home.tsx.

Pune.note: Generic Unsplash aerial-urban-area stock photo. The site's own search context surfaced it under a 'Pune' tag, but the photo's own title is generic ('aerial view of urban area') and we have not independently verified it actually depicts Pune. Treat as an atmosphere shot only, not proof of place, until a real Pune photo replaces it.
